meta.description: 9:00am IST. Surfaces trial_3m renewals at 21 / 14 / 7 days as a ClickUp task on sales. Does not message the parent until sales says so.

parameters.query:
select e.id as enrollment_id, a.name, e.renewal_date, e.monthly_fee_inr,
  (e.renewal_date - current_date) as days_left
from enrollments e
join alcovians a on a.enrollment_id = e.id
where e.plan = 'trial_3m'
  and (e.renewal_date - current_date) in (21, 14, 7)
  and not exists (
    select 1 from nudges_sent n
    where n.alcovian_id = a.id
      and n.trigger = 'renewal_due'
      and n.sent_at::date = current_date
  );

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: `Renewal ${$json.days_left}d — ${$json.name}`, description: `${$json.name} trial renews on ${$json.renewal_date}. Fee ${$json.monthly_fee_inr}. Ask sales: call this week. Do not auto-message the parent.` }) }}

parameters.query:
insert into nudges_sent (alcovian_id, trigger, channel, sent_at)
select a.id, 'renewal_due', 'clickup', now()
from enrollments e join alcovians a on a.enrollment_id = e.id
where e.id = $1::uuid;
